comment: sidecar-update-public-state.json in this directory is a byte-for-byte copy of the contracts repository's offline ABI
fixture of one finalized devnet sidecar approval cascade (LicenseEntry, GlobalSidecarApproval, LocalSidecarApproval
with a Some pin, ResellerSidecarApproval, ResellerEntry) under the licence-registry program the contracts declare at
this commit. Public account data only: it holds no key material. Do not edit the copy. To take a newer contracts
fixture, copy the file from a newer contracts commit on main, update every field below from that commit, and replace
keyless_sidecar_test.go checks on every run, without a contracts clone, that the copy's sha256 and git blob id are
the ones recorded here and that the recorded commit holds that blob at sourcePath, then runs the Store's keyless and
key-bearing cascade over these bytes; the update controller's keyless gate test reads the same copy. With
MELUSINA_CONTRACTS_GIT_DIR (scripts/run-tests.sh) it also checks that sourceCommit is on the contracts main line; a
release or CI run fails without one.
